result.title: AcmeCRM closes seed round to hire support staff
result.text: AcmeCRM announced a seed round in August to hire support staff. The company said its published pricing is not changing.

result.title: AcmeCRM Pricing
result.text:
AcmeCRM Pricing
Starter: $12 per seat per month, billed annually.
Pro: $29 per seat per month, billed annually.
Enterprise: contact sales.
